site.title: Climate City 2126
site.location: Bulgaria, Black Sea coast (placeholder site, to be decided by the group)
site.note: All text below is a draft. Verify facts and add sources before the demo.

pins.title: Nuclear energy hub
pins.summary: Steady baseload power for a hotter world. The adaptation question is cooling: reactors need a lot of water, and droughts and warmer water shrink the safety margin.
pins.details: Real-world reference: Kozloduy, Bulgaria's only nuclear plant, sits on the Danube. Discuss river versus sea-water cooling, flood-proofing the site, and why storage and renewables are still needed. TODO: add current figures and sources.

pins.title: Drought-tolerant crop farms
pins.summary: Fields of heat- and drought-tolerant crop varieties, some of them gene-edited. They show how plant biology can cut the water needed per kilogram of food.
pins.details: Discuss: how EU rules treat gene-edited plants, Bulgaria's traditionally cautious public view of GMOs, and the risks (less genetic diversity, seed dependence). TODO: verify the current EU regulation status and cite it.

pins.title: Coastal wetland buffer
pins.summary: A restored lagoon belt that soaks up storm surge and gives migrating birds a place to rest. A natural flood defence that doubles as habitat.
pins.details: Reference: the lakes around Burgas, on a major bird migration route along the Black Sea. Move the slider to +100 years and watch the wetland shift inland. TODO: add species and numbers.

pins.title: Sponge district
pins.summary: Permeable paving, green roofs and retention basins that hold cloudburst water instead of sending it down the street.
pins.details: Discuss: flash floods, where the water is stored, and reusing it for irrigation in dry spells. TODO: pick one Bulgarian flood event as the case study.

pins.title: Elevated waterfront
pins.summary: The lowest districts are raised or turned into flood-tolerant public space. Everything critical sits above the +100 year water line.
pins.details: Use the scenario slider to show why. Discuss managed retreat versus defending the coastline, and what each costs.

pins.title: Cooling green corridors
pins.summary: Tree-lined streets and wind corridors that lower street temperatures during heatwaves, planted with heat- and drought-tolerant species.
pins.details: Discuss: the urban heat island effect, native versus imported species, and biodiversity benefits. TODO: choose species that suit Bulgaria's climate.
